S: she insists you drink it every day
Fresh ginger, turmeric, lemon and honey blitzed with apple juice and strained, served in shot glasses. No tannis root.

Hand-chopped eye fillet with shallot, capers, cornichons, Dijon and Worcestershire, topped with a raw egg yolk and served with crisp potato crisps and toast. Chill 400g very fresh eye fillet in the freezer for 20 minutes, then chop very finely by hand. Mix with 1 finely diced shallot, 1 tbsp chopped capers, 4 chopped cornichons, 2 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, a dash of hot sauce, chopped parsley, salt and pepper. Shape into 4 rounds on cold plates and set an egg yolk on each. Serve straight away with thin toast and potato crisps.

M: Rosemary's rare rib eye with frites
Rosemary can't stop eating meat barely cooked

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and pulled rare, sliced over golden frites, with garlic butter and a watercress salad sharp with Dijon dressing. Salt 2 rib eye steaks (about 450g each) and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Bake 800g frozen frites at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute, until 48C inside, about 6 minutes. Add 40g butter and 2 garlic cloves, baste for 1 minute, then rest 8 minutes. Toss 100g watercress with 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar and 3 tbsp olive oil. Slice the steak and serve.

s.note: she insists you drink it every day
s.how: Blitz a 5cm knob of ginger and a 5cm piece of fresh turmeric with the juice of 2 lemons, 2 tbsp honey and 250ml apple juice. Strain and pour into shot glasses. No tannis root.

s.note: the welcome party in the old building
s.how: Sear 400g trimmed chicken livers in butter until pink inside, then flame with 2 tbsp brandy. Blitz with 150g soft butter and thyme and set in a dish for 4 hours. Spread on toasted baguette with a little fig jam.

m.note: a Manhattan club sandwich between auditions
m.how: Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Toast 12 slices of bread. Layer 300g sliced roast chicken, bacon, lettuce and 2 sliced tomatoes with mayo across three slices each. Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.

w.note: with the chalky undertaste, ours is smooth
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 30g butter. Whisk in 3 yolks, then fold in 3 whites whipped with 40g sugar, then 150ml whipped cream. Spoon into small cups and set 4 hours. Unlike Minnie's, nothing chalky in it.

d.how: Slice a knob of ginger and bruise 2 lemongrass stalks. Steep in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes. Strain and sweeten with honey and lemon juice. Pour into four cups.
